comments: cd3593ef: This is a routine or entry point. It calls the DE line tag, and then goes to the BEGIN line label.
a889265d: This line performs some pre-processing by executing the DE line tag before going to BEGIN.

a6c55e3f: This sets the variables for file editing. DIE is the global root, DIC is the same as DIE, DP is the file number, DL=1 means this is the top-level file, DIEL=0 disables input transformations, and DU is null. It then checks if the record has any multiples and quits if not.
1c7097e5: If the DT node exists in the zero node of this record, it stores the 8th piece of that node (the last edited date/time) in the local DE(1) variable.
52919185: This kills the %Z local variable used earlier and exits the line tag.
40d77ad5: ;Write the description label.
74c8d1da: ;Quit if this is a null value.
2565df80: ;Output the prompt.
0e48b178: ;If the data length is greater than 19 characters, it's not a date/time value, and it's a free text or key type, go to DIR2 for handling.
c787111d: ;If there is input and it's not a date/time value and it's a set of codes, write 'No Editing' and quit.
918241c0: ;Read the user's input or timeout after DTIME seconds.
c40b1ee7: ;Quit.
25da0891: Increment the current question number
e3320f07: Transfer control to execute the next question
0be77f35: If the question has been answered previously, go to display the previous response; otherwise write the question prompt and field attributes

b01b57e6: If the user enters a null response, quit if the field is not required, go to the next question if the field has a XECUTABLE 'XAM' help, go to the previous question if the field is a computed multiple and there are no entries, or go to prompting for the question again
bed284df: If the user enters a '?', go to display the available choices for the field; if the user enters '^', delete the data and go to exit
df1d7abc: If the user enters '@', delete the data and go to the line editor

550892b1: If the user enters a space and the field is a DATE/TIME, not a POINTER, and the site parameter for defaults is set, set the default response to the site parameter value; if the field is not WORD-PROCESSING and not LAYGO, display the default response

6b51868a: If the field has a Transform for Output or is pointed to by another file, evaluate the transform logic or DINUM logic. If the transform or DINUM logic writes something to the device, go to the reader input for the next response; otherwise, prepare to loop through the multiple choices for the response
e092fc5c: Loop through the multiple choices for the response. For each choice, execute any DINUM screening logic. Quit the loop if a match is found between the user response and one of the choices

457f7266: If no match was found between the user response and any of the multiple choices, write out the remaining portion of the last multiple choice and set the response to the external value of that choice
90d08522: If the returned value of ^DIC is negative, exit.
ca6be2a6: If a number is provided without 'N' node, validate length and exit if exceeds 24.
e059ea1e: If a number is provided with a decimal place, remove leading zeros and trailing decimal zeros.
2e98af5f: Execute code referenced by the X variable and clear YS array.
d842cc5e: If a value was returned, store it in the DG array and, if the 'd' flag is present, store it in ^DISV for the current user.
8da91e27: If there is a cross-reference description for the current field, branch to Z^DIE17 to execute additional code.
6cb7baf4: If an error has occurred, set X to '?BAD' to indicate a bad data value.
5c422397: Perform any field-specific logic (stored in the 'D' xref) and queue up the field for post-processing (QQ^DIEQ). Then branch to the 'B' label.
8f2d7b73: Set the D array entry for the current field with its attributes (field number, computed value, user input, word-processing parameters, and executable help prompt).
dc322768: If there is no field input transform defined, branch to the appropriate label based on the type of the user input (RD for range input, A for audit trail, or X for setting X to the input).
2d5f5c34: Set DG to the computed value of the field, Y to the input transform, and X to the user input. If there is a second input transform, execute it. Then branch to the RP label.
ea9782f0: ;Get the value of a pointer to a file entry.
b0e78c76: ;Get the value of a pointer to a subentry in a file.
451ff92a: ;If the DATA tag is present, execute the DATA dictionary code. If the SPECIFIER tag is present, extract the specified string from the input string.
52a3660c: ;Branching to different lines of code based on certain conditions
2851cad3: If the input is neither 'I' nor '#', go to the label 'RD'.
ca48839e: Call the routine 'E^DIE0'. If 'X' is defined, go to the label 'RD'. Otherwise, go to the label 'PR'.
42134451: Quit the routine.
7a6dc189: Set variable 'DNM' to 'DGJXA16' and 'DQ' to 1.
76cfd2fc: Set variable 'DW' to 'DT;8', 'DV' to 'P200', 'DU' to an empty string, 'DLB' to 'REVIEWED BY', and 'DIFLD' to 10.08.
85b70d12: Append 'VA(200,' to the variable 'DU'.
25a3f29f: Go to the label 'RE'.
b8ffd085: Quit the label 'X1'.

7e8183ec: If the variable 'DG' is greater than 9, execute the routine 'F^DIE17' and the label 'DE'. Set 'Y' to the up-arrow character, 'DQ' to 2, and execute the label 'X2'. If 'Y' is undefined or equal to the up-arrow character, go to the label 'A'. Otherwise, set 'X' to 'Y', 'DIC(0)' to 'F', 'DW' to the value of 'DQ', and go to the label 'OUT^DIE17'.
f4833662: If 'X' is an empty string, set the 7th piece of the zero node of the global 'VAS(393,D0,"DT")' to an empty string, set 'DGJTST' to 'SIGNED', and set 'Y' to '@2'.
21148e69: Quit the label 'X2'.

719dbdb1: If the variable 'DG' is greater than 9, execute the routine 'F^DIE17' and the label 'DE'. Set 'Y' to the up-arrow character, 'DQ' to 3, and execute the label 'X3'. If 'Y' is undefined or equal to the up-arrow character, go to the label 'A'. Otherwise, set 'X' to 'Y', 'DIC(0)' to 'F', 'DW' to the value of 'DQ', and go to the label 'OUT^DIE17'.
77d5c7c2: Set flag indicating test was REVIEWED.
54d15555: Quit if status of test is REVIEWED.

16dd3604: If the DG array is defined and has more than 9 nodes, call F^DIE17 to file data, reset 'DQ' to 5, call X5 to get next entry in B cross-reference, check if resulting 'Y' is defined or equal to '^', if so go to label A, otherwise set 'X' to 'Y', set flags in DIC for fields-only editing, set 'DW' to 5, and go to OUT^DIE17.
f9a5879d: Get next entry in 'B' cross-reference of ^DG(393.2 global for current value of DGJTST.
b818eb53: Quit after getting next 'B' cross-reference entry.
388fcac6: If DG array has more than 9 nodes, execute F^DIE17 to file data, then go to ^DGJXA17.
